title: Operation of Margin Accounts, Marking-to-Market, and Clearing Mechanics
prerequisites: Futures contract definition and standardized specifications
Long vs short position mechanics and basic PnL calculation
learningOutcomes: Explain the operation of futures margin accounts and the 75% maintenance threshold rule
Calculate daily marking-to-market settlements, margin account balances, and variation margin calls
Contrast central counterparty (CCP) clearing with bilateral OTC clearing, ISDA agreements, and collateral haircuts
Analyze the systemic collapse of Long-Term Capital Management ($4B loss) driven by extreme leverage and collateral drains

sections.title: The Purpose and Operation of Margin Accounts
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Explain why futures exchanges require performance bond deposits to eliminate party default risk.
keyPoints: Margin accounts act as collateral performance bonds rather than borrowed money loans.
Long and short positions face symmetric margin requirements set by the clearinghouse.
Brokers accept Treasury bills at 90% face value and shares at 50% market value as initial collateral.

sections.title: Daily Settlement and Marking to Market (MTM)
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Master the end-of-day re-pricing mechanism that resets contract values to zero daily.
keyPoints: Each trading day, contracts are settled at closing price and rewritten at the new settlement level.
Daily profits are credited in cash to the winning account; losses are debited immediately.
Maintenance margin is set at approximately 75% of initial margin to absorb daily volatility.

sections.title: Example 2.1: 16-Day Gold Futures Margin Walkthrough
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Follow day-by-day cash flows in a 200 oz gold position to calculate exact margin call obligations.
keyPoints: Two gold contracts require $12,000 initial margin and $9,000 maintenance margin.
On Day 7, gold drops to $1,226.90, dipping account balance to $7,380 ($1,620 below maintenance).
Crucial rule: The investor must deposit $4,620 variation margin to restore balance to initial $12,000.

sections.title: Central Counterparty (CCP) vs Bilateral OTC Clearing
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Contrast clearinghouse multilateral netting and default funds with OTC bilateral ISDA CSA rules.
keyPoints: CCPs act as legal counterparty to every trade through novation, eliminating bilateral credit risk.
Bilateral OTC trades rely on ISDA master agreements and Credit Support Annexes with collateral thresholds.
Post-2008 Dodd-Frank and Basel regulations mandate standardized OTC derivatives clear through CCPs.

sections.title: Business Snapshot 2.2: The LTCM $4B Collapse
sections.pedagogicalObjective: Demonstrate how excessive leverage and flight-to-quality spread widening caused $4B in liquidation losses.
keyPoints: LTCM traded convergence arbitrage, assuming liquid and illiquid bond spreads would narrow.
The August 1998 Russian debt default triggered a flight to quality, blowing spreads wide open.
LTCM suffered simultaneous collateral drains on both legs, forcing fire-sale liquidation of $4 billion.

misconceptions.misconception: A margin call only requires depositing enough money to get back above the maintenance margin.
misconceptions.authorRebuttal: John C. Hull emphasizes that when a margin call occurs, the investor must deposit variation margin to bring the account balance all the way back up to the INITIAL margin level, not merely the maintenance level.

misconceptions.misconception: Short futures positions require borrowing the underlying asset like stock short sales.
misconceptions.authorRebuttal: In futures markets, entering a short position is completely symmetric to entering a long position, requiring identical initial margin with no borrowing of physical goods.

activeRecallQuiz.scenario: An investor enters 2 gold futures contracts (200 oz total). Initial margin is $6,000/contract ($12,000 total) and maintenance margin is $4,500/contract ($9,000 total). After adverse price moves, the account balance drops to $7,800.
activeRecallQuiz.question: How much variation margin cash must the investor deposit by the close of the next business day?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: $4,200 (to restore the account balance back to the initial margin of $12,000)
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Because the $7,800 balance is below the $9,000 maintenance margin, a margin call is triggered. The variation margin required is $12,000 - $7,800 = $4,200, restoring the account to the full initial margin.

coreTakeaways: Margin accounts and daily marking-to-market eliminate default risk in futures trading.
Maintenance margin is 75% of initial margin; margin calls require topping up to full initial margin.
CCPs eliminate bilateral default risk through novation, netting, and default guaranty funds.
Excessive leverage can turn manageable market fluctuations into catastrophic collateral liquidation.
